As an Information Technology Operations Manager you are responsible to monitor the operation of all computer hardware installation and maintenance and your role will include key responsibilities such as- Serve as primary contact for all servicing of computer PC hardware. Maintain licenses for all software and ensure that the proper maintenance contacts cover all systems. Maintain a sufficient inventory of computer related supplies. Maintain a log of all computer hardware and a log of all services calls on computer hardware. Manage the configuration records, programme files and data files on the computer system. Monitor the performance of the computer software and maintain a log of performance reports, error and integrity check reports, system malfunctions and solutions. Interact with IT Systems Support and other IT Services Partners to ensure IT Support services are delivered on time appropriately. Comply with the hotel environmental, health and safety policies and procedures. An excellent command of English and the ability to design networks and provide technical leads are essential. Knowledge & Competencies The ideal candidate will be dynamic, well qualified, with a high level of motivation and enthusiasm and the ability to adapt to unpredictable events. You are pro-active, reliable and deliver accurate and timely performance and should possess following competencies- Understanding the Business Planning for Business Valuing Diversity Customer Focus Influencing Outcomes Team Building Leading People Managing Operations Adaptability Drive for Results

review_candidates.title: Bilingual Senior AWS Platform Engineer
review_candidates.description: Overview At KPMG in Canada, our people bring their unique perspectives to Canada’s most important challenges. Here, you can build momentum that reaches beyond our business, develop skills for the future, and take ownership of your career with support at every stage. Join a firm where your career can make a difference. At KPMG, you will join a team responsible for delivering secure, scalable, and reliable cloud platforms that enable innovation across the firm. As part of the National Architecture – Platforms & Services group, this role supports the operational management, governance, automation, and continuous improvement of enterprise AWS platform capabilities. We are seeking a Senior AWS Platform Engineer to manage platform-level activities across two AWS Organizations. The role is focused on AWS platform administration, Terraform-led automation, cloud governance, operational reporting, and stakeholder communication. The successful candidate will bring strong technical depth, a self-starter mindset, and the ability to communicate platform status, risks, and recommendations clearly through documentation and stakeholder-ready presentations. What You Will Do Manage platform-level activities for two AWS Organizations within the National Architecture – Platforms & Services group. Administer, govern, and evolve enterprise AWS environments, including multi-account structures, account lifecycle patterns, and organization-level controls. Design and maintain Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code standards, reusable modules, and deployment patterns that improve consistency, scalability, and operational reliability. Develop and support automation for AWS account provisioning, cloud configuration, identity controls, networking standards, monitoring, and operational processes. Support cloud governance activities, including platform guardrails, security controls, compliance alignment, tagging standards, and configuration baselines. Partner with architecture, security, operations, application, and business teams to translate requirements into secure and supportable cloud platform capabilities. Monitor platform health, availability, reliability, and operational trends; identify and drive improvements to resiliency, automation, and supportability. Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, automation, deployment, and platform issues, including coordination with internal teams and vendors where required. Produce clear operational reporting on platform activities, risks, progress, adoption, and improvement opportunities. Prepare and present status decks, roadmaps, risks, accomplishments, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholder audiences. Contribute to cloud engineering standards, DevOps practices, platform documentation, and knowledge sharing across the team. Take ownership of assigned outcomes and proactively identify opportunities to improve platform efficiency, cost management, control maturity, and operational effectiveness. What You Bring To The Role Extensive hands-on experience administering, engineering, and supporting AWS environments in an enterprise setting. Strong experience working with AWS Organizations, multi-account operating models, and shared cloud platform services. Expert-level Terraform capability, including module design, reusable patterns, remote state, workspace governance, and CI/CD integration. Strong understanding of cloud architecture, networking, identity and access management, logging, monitoring, security, and operational best practices. Ability to work independently as a self-starter while managing multiple priorities and driving work through ambiguity. Strong communication, documentation, stakeholder management, and presentation skills, including the ability to create and deliver status decks to stakeholder groups. Ability to explain technical platform concepts clearly to both technical stakeholders and business-facing audiences. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with a continuous improvement mindset. Experience collaborating across architecture, security, engineering, operations, procurement, vendor, and business teams. Bilingual communication skills are strongly preferred. Technical Skills AWS Organizations, organizational units, service control policies, account structures, and multi-account governance patterns. Terraform and Terraform Cloud or Terraform Enterprise, including module development, state management, workspace design, policy controls, and pipeline integration. AWS identity, access, and security services such as IAM, IAM Identity Center, CloudTrail, AWS Config, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Systems Manager, and related governance capabilities. AWS networking and connectivity concepts including VPCs, routing, security groups, DNS, private connectivity, VPN, and Direct Connect concepts. CI/CD tooling such as GitHub, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or comparable platforms. Scripting and automation using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar languages. Monitoring, logging, alerting, observability, and operational reporting for cloud platform services. Cloud cost management, tagging, policy enforcement, configuration standards, and operational control design. Container, Kubernetes, or broader platform engineering experience is considered an asset. The following certifications would be considered an asset but are not required AWS Certified Solutions Architect, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, HashiCorp Terraform Associate or equivalent Terraform certification Additional cloud, security, networking, DevOps, or automation certifications are all considered assets as well but not required. This position requires written and oral fluency in English. The successful candidate may be required to support or collaborate with English-speaking colleagues or stakeholders while at KPMG. The successful candidate may be required to create, interpret and/or apply policies, practices, laws and and/or regulations during the regular course of their employment. KPMG Ontario Region Pay Range Information The expected base salary range for this position is $74,000 - $111,000 and may be eligible for bonus awards. The determination of an applicant’s base salary within this range is based on the individual’s location, skills & competencies, and unique qualifications. In addition, KPMG offers a comprehensive and competitive Total Rewards program. Providing you with the support you need to be at your best Our Values, The KPMG Way Integrity , we do what is right | Excellence , we never stop learning and improving | Courage , we think and act boldly | Together , we respect each other and draw strength from our differences | For Better , we do what matters KPMG in Canada is a proud equal opportunities employer and we are committed to creating a respectful, inclusive and barrier-free workplace that allows all of our people to reach their full potential. A diverse workforce is key to our success and we believe in bringing your whole self to work. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply and hope you will choose KPMG in Canada as your employer of choice. Adjustments and accommodations throughout the recruitment process At KPMG, we are committed to fostering an inclusive recruitment process where all candidates can be themselves and excel. We aim to provide a positive experience and are prepared to offer adjustments or accommodations to help you perform at your best. Adjustments (informal requests), such as extra preparation time or the option for micro breaks during interviews, and accommodations (formal requests), such as accessible communication supports or technology aids, are tailored to individual needs and role requirements. You will have an opportunity to request an adjustment or accommodation at any point throughout the recruitment process. If you require support, please contact KPMG’s Employee Relations Service team by calling 1-888-466-4778. AI Usage We embrace the use of artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance the candidate experience and streamline our recruitment processes. AI tools may help with organizing applications or surfacing relevant qualifications. However, no hiring decisions are made using AI. Every hiring decision is made by our hiring managers and recruitment professionals, who are equipped with training that empowers them to use these tools responsibly. AI technologies used in our recruitment process undergo detailed risk assessments, including security and privacy requirements, that align with KPMG’s Trusted AI framework. We believe technology should empower human judgment, not replace it. It’s one of the many ways we’re delivering on our vision of being a technology-first, people-driven firm.
